purpose: Evaluation metadata only; never passed to detector, training sampler, tracking or events.

decision_policy.counter_without_hand: TP must exceed both baselines on the fixed six frames
decision_policy.cash_in_hand: TP must be at least both baselines (strict no-loss guard; one target = 10 percentage points)
decision_policy.empty_counter_false_positives: Zero preferred; report both baseline comparisons
decision_policy.id_to_cash: No higher than either baseline; zero preferred
decision_policy.production_promotion: Never automatic. No full pipeline in this experiment.

limitations: 42 frames from only two correlated video sequences; not an independent new test set.
Annotations are provisional assistant visual review, not independent human ground truth.
Previous candidate was selected with these validation sources; new candidate uses a fixed final epoch without held-out checkpoint selection.
